instructions: Every accepted comparison must include an image path to an archived current-renderer PNG under specs/webgpu-skinned-crowd/visualizations/. Generate a pending manifest with npm run archive:current-renderer, review the side-by-side report, then change statuses only for comparisons that are actually accepted.

menu-ready.note: Menu readability and WebGPU capability messaging accepted.

menu-unsupported.note: No legacy equivalent existed; WebGPU-only unsupported state is accepted.

battle-default.note: WebGPU crowd density, terrain, and team colors accepted.

battle-selection-hud-dpr2.note: Selection, minimap, unit cards, and DPR2 input readability accepted.

campaign-whole-map.note: Roads, borders, labels, territory, water, and clouds accepted.

campaign-label-zoom.note: City, army, road, and label readability accepted.
